source_caption:
Gia (1998) is a biographical drama that tells the story of Gia Carangi, one of the earliest supermodels to rise to international fame in the late 1970s and early 1980s. With Angelina Jolie delivering a powerful, career-defining performance, the film follows Gia’s meteoric ascent in the fashion world while revealing the personal struggles and emotional challenges she faced along the way. As she confronts the intense pressures of the modeling industry and searches for love, identity, and meaning, the film presents a moving portrait of a woman trying to find her place in a demanding world.

The cast also includes memorable performances from Elizabeth Mitchell and Faye Dunaway. Through its honest depiction of both the glamour and the darker realities behind success, Gia captures the complexity of a life shaped by fame, vulnerability, and hardship, leaving a lasting impression on the world of fashion.

source_details.title: Gia
source_details.synopsis: Gia is a 1998 American biographical drama television film about the life and times of one of the first supermodels, Gia Carangi. The film stars Angelina Jolie as Gia and Faye Dunaway as Wilhelmina Cooper, with Mercedes Ruehl and Elizabeth Mitchell. It was directed by Michael Cristofer and written by Cristofer and Jay McInerney. The original music score was composed by Terence Blanchard. The film premiered on January 31, 1998, on HBO.
